name: What should I prepare before meeting an accessible bathroom remodeling company?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting an accessible bathroom remodeling company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before demolition, photograph the room, record fixture and doorway measurements, list difficult activities, and gather product or finish preferences. Elite Remodeling & Design may use consultation, layout development, 3D visualization, selections, permitting coordination, construction, and inspection as part of the project process. Context: Early decisions about shower type, seat, bars, controls, tile, and storage influence plumbing, framing, waterproofing, and ordering. Key factors: household schedule, alternate bathroom access, budget range, mobility equipment, desired completion window, and whether walls or floors may change. Practical guidance: Prepare a must-have list and a flexible wish list. Tell the team about leaks, prior repairs, or changes in mobility. Clear the room and protect medications or personal items before the confirmed start date.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare photos, measurements, difficult-task notes, mobility-device dimensions, budget priorities, desired timing, finish ideas, and information about leaks or prior repairs. Separate must-have accessibility features from optional upgrades, and tell the remodeler whether another bathroom will be available during construction.
